items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Slappy White, Billy Eckstein, the all these guys played there, you know, and my band backed these guys, you know?

ctx.x: -- I took it with a grain of salt. But one morning, at five o'clock the phone rang, and he says, "Hey man, this is Billy Williams. You ready to go to Vegas? We open up in two weeks." And man, this was three months afterwards. So I had to go talk to the boss which was Hank [Sabis.] He brought attractions in his club like Sarah Vaughn,

Slappy White, Billy Eckstein, the all these guys played there, you know, and my band backed these guys, you know? Redd Foxx was there. Redd Foxx came there and broke it up, man, just like he is doing, you know. So I had to get a leave of absence from the owner. I wanted an eight-week absence -- leave of absence to go play with Billy Williams. I'm still on that eight week absence. I never went back. But we went to Vegas and played the Riviera and the Starlight Room, six different times. First time, we went there…
